effect.name: GM Text Marquee
effect.desc: An endless ticker. The line is joined into a ring with a gap of your choosing and then scrolled through a fixed window, so the text never runs out and never jumps - it wraps seamlessly. Three motion modes: Loop runs the ring forever, Ping-Pong runs it out and brings it back, and Reveal Once travels a single pass then holds at the far end. The window is a fraction of the original line, the anchor decides where the window sits inside the frame, and the whole thing can run on the layer's own clock or on absolute timeline time so several tickers can share one scroll.
